svg.title: Six SDLC phases, each with an executable gate
svg.desc: A phase is detected from the request; it only advances when its gate passes. No gate, no progress.
svg.text: Six SDLC phases, each with an executable gate
A phase is detected from the request; it only advances when its gate passes. No gate, no progress.
Gate fails → the phase does not advance
The harness explains what is missing (for example: “diffs pending — si aplicar or no first”) and adds to the agentic debt. When debt reaches 100, Build is blocked
until it is paid down with onboard, applied changes or verified Done.
No phase detected? → Flash · clarify before touching disk
